user.title: Connect to BombeCam
user.description: Enter the address of the BombeCam gateway (for example http://192.168.1.12:8654) and an API token minted on the BombeCam computer.

reauth_confirm.title: BombeCam token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {url} rejected the stored token. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The config entry no longer exists.
